title: Waldheimstraße, Ostfildern
description:
I am renting out my furnished apartment in Ostfildern.

The U7 stop at Zinsholz is a 7-minute walk away. Scharnhauser Park, with all its shopping options, is also nearby.

The apartment is furnished (washing machine, built-in kitchen with stove, dishwasher, refrigerator). It includes a bedroom closet, bed, and desk with chair.

The apartment is available starting in April.

The base rent is 1,250 EUR per month + utilities.

Please contact me if you are interested. 

The apartment is also suitable for a shared living arrangement.

title: Mergenthalerstraße, Ostfildern
description: Im Wohnviertel gibt es paar Hundert Meter entfernt alles, was man will. Die Lebensmitelgeschäfte sind außerhalb des Wohnorts, sonst Bäcker, Cafés und Gaststätten, Apotheke und Läden für dies und das sind in der Nähe. Eine Busstation von der Buslinie 130 und 131 ist nah. Die Busse fahren nach Esslingen, aber an der U-Bahn-Station vorbei, die 5 Minuten entfern liegt. Mit der U-Bahn fährt man dann für 23 Min. nach Stuttgart Mitte.

title: Mergenthalerstraße, Ostfildern
description:
***Not suitable for long-term rent***

Economy Quadruple Room

A modern basement apartment that is suitable as a shared apartment and is also used as such. The apartment has
3 separate rooms,
each with 2 single beds and a bunk bed.
The kitchen is separate with a stove, 2 large refrigerators.
A washroom with 2 toilets and a urinal are available.
Each room has a separate shower cubicle for private use. The 3 shower cubicles are equipped with modern massage showers (one on a tripod and the second mobile) and are located in a shared wet room that can be locked. There are also 2 sinks with a large mirror. A washing machine and a dryer are also there. More pictures on request.
Each room is furnished with a table + wardrobe and 2 chairs. Linen is changed every week. towels are there (no bath towels).
WiFi with a repeater to boost the internet signal is available on site.

Minimum stay 2 nights! 
The price for the rent for 1 month is 850 € also just for a one guest. every one more must pay extra 150 € for 1 Month

Quiet after 10 p.m
SMOKING is not permitted in the property. A smoking place in front of the entrance is specially set up and nicely equipped.
Hygiene in the kitchen and on the toilet after use is a matter of course.
No open food should be left on the table.
WASTE SEPARATION is MANDATORY.

Parking is free on the street outside but private parking is also available at €5 per day.
The renatal price is just for 1 person!
Each another person + 200€
